name: Incremental Preconditioned Gradient Method
aliases: Incremental Preconditioned Gradient Method for Reflective Tomography
definition: An online learning method that incrementally updates a voxel model $\phi \in \mathbb{R}^N$ to minimize modeling error for reflective tomography, using a preconditioned gradient descent on a least-squares cost function.
summary: The Incremental Preconditioned Gradient Method is an online learning algorithm for reflective tomography that incrementally updates a voxel model using frame-driven preconditioned gradient descent to prioritize high-frequency spatial information.
